verses.text: Ha exxo patrón ex, tojolnhej tzeyutej he b'a t'a heb' he chekab', wach' tzeyutej he b'a t'a heb'. Tze nakoti to ay junxo t'a satcha'anh tzex ak'an mandar, haton Kajal Jesús.
Ha exxo he masanil, tzex lesalwi wal t'a smasanil he k'ool t'a Dios t'a masanil tiempo. Tzeyak'anpax yuj diosal t'ay.
Hanhejtona', tzex lesalwi pax kuuj, yik wach' ol och Dios Kajal ket'ok, yik ol yal kalanel slolonel yet' yab'ixal Cristo ak'b'ilxo kojtakejeli. Ha tiknaik preso waji, yujto swalel yab'ixal tik.
Lesalwanhek wuuj, yik ol yal walanel yab'ixal Cristo t'a stojolal.
Ayik tze k'uman heb' manto creyenteok t'a juntak el, wach' tzeyutej he b'a t'a heb'.
Wach'nhej tzeyutej he loloni, tze ch'oxanel he wach'k'olal t'a heb'. Tato icha chi' ol nachajel eyuuj tas ol aj he pakan tas sk'anb'ej junjun heb' t'ayex.
Ha winh kuk'tak Tíquico tik, xajan wal winh kuuj. Tek'an wal smunlaj winh t'a ko Mam Dios. Ayoch winh yak'an serwil Kajal Jesús wet'ok. Ol b'at winh yal t'ayex tastak kaj t'a tik.
Tzin chekpaxb'at winh t'ayex ta' yik ol yak' yip he k'ool winh.

Hanhejtona' ol b'at pax winh kuk'tak Onésimo yet' winh. Ha winhaj Onésimo tik, eyetchonhab' winh, te xajan winh kuuj. Tek'anxo winh. Haton chawanh heb' winh tik ol b'at halan t'ayex tastak kaj t'a tik.

Haxo pax winhaj Aristarco, preso yaj winh wet' t'a tik. Syak'paxb'at stzatzil he k'ool winh. Yet' winhaj Marcos, haton winh sk'ab' yok sb'a yet' winhaj Bernabé, syak'paxb'at stzatzil he k'ool winh. Walnakxo t'ayex yuj winhaj Marcos tik, tato ol b'at winh ta', tze cha winh sk'och t'a tzalajk'olal.

Haxo winhaj Jesús tik, haton winh skuch pax Justo, syak'paxb'at stzatzil he k'ool winh. Ha t'a skal heb' winh smunlaj wet'ok, anhej heb' winh chawanh tik wetisraelal. Tz'ek' heb' winh yaleli chajtil tz'aj yoch heb' anima t'a yol sk'ab' Dios. Ha heb' winh chawanh tik, syak' wal sniwanil in k'ool heb' winh.

Ha winh eyetchonhab' Epafras tik, ayoch pax winh yak'an serwil Cristo wet'ok. Slesalwi wal winh eyuuj, yik tzex wach' tek'k'aji, yik anhej wal juntzanh tas snib'ej Dios b'aj tze wach' ak'ejoch he pensar.
Ha in tik, swak' testigoal in b'a, swalani to tzex sna winh. Snaanpaxb'at heb' ay t'a Laodicea winh yet' heb' ay t'a Hierápolis.
Haxo winhaj Lucas, winh anhtum, xajan wal winh kuuj yet' pax winhaj Demas, syak'paxb'at stzatzil he k'ool heb' winh.
Skak'paxb'at stzatzil sk'ool heb' creyente ay t'a Laodicea. Skak'anpaxb'at stzatzil sk'ool ix kanab' Ninfas yet' heb' creyente smolb'ej sb'a t'a spat ix.

Ayik ol lajwok eyawtan jun carta tik t'a yichanh heb' creyente ta', tzeyak'paxb'at t'a heb' aj Laodicea, yik wach' ol awtaj pax t'a skal heb' ta'. Haxo tze chaan sk'och jun carta ol yak'paxta heb' aj Laodicea chi' t'ayex, tzeyawtej paxi.
Haxo t'a winh kuk'tak Arquipo, tzeyal t'a winh icha tik: Ak'wal ip a munlaj t'a jun opisio ix yak' Kajal Jesús tik t'ayach, xe chi t'a winh.
Ha in Pablo in tik, a in wal lak'an tzin tz'ib'ejb'at jun stzatzil he k'ool tik. Naekkoti to preso waj t'a tik. Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Dios t'ayex ta'.
